categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies transaction creation and fee-bumping logic in src/wallet/spend.cpp and src/wallet/feebumper.cpp
categories.rationale: Prevents wallet fingerprinting caused by replacement transactions randomly receiving an older nLockTime than the original transaction. While the wallet rubric prioritizes transaction creation privacy and fingerprinting protection, this specific locktime backdating occurs on only an estimated 2% of fee-bumped transactions, making the fix worthwhile but reasonably deferrable.
